accountBlocker: EE browser session is signed out; cannot complete non-interactive account-specific fresh checks. Owner media permission remains recorded and valid.
basis: Five individual Banpresto spreadsheet candidates marked In Stock; Killua has a public exact-SKU five-photo gallery. Supplier-account stock/MAP and SKU-level demand remain unverified; Killua owner-rule price exceeds observed EE retail item price.

priorityCategories.gates: Verified PetEdge/BCI supplier feed, channel and photo permission; no publication from unverified feeds.

profitPolicy: Preserve unit cost × 1.50. This equals 33.3% gross margin before expenses; never silently change price to meet MAP or market pricing. Flag/exclude uneconomic or MAP-conflicting SKUs.

uxResearch.pattern: Separate Company/manufacturer from franchise/character; relevant product-type facets and counts.
Keyboard and tap-to-expand photo galleries, exact item identity, age/player count and packaging specifications.
Explicit assembly condition and painted-photo disclosure for model kits; do not assume these apply to every kit.
